outer = json.load(sys.stdin)
inner = json.loads(outer['result'])

    exp = eval_exps[eid]
    print('='*100)
    print(f'EXP_ID: {eid}')
    print('='*100)
    print(json.dumps(exp, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    print()
" 2>&1
